sloka: अथाङ्गदो मुष्टिविभिन्नमूर्धा सुस्राव तीव्रं रुधिरं भृशोष्णम्।मुहुर्विजज्वाल मुमोह चापि सञ्ज्ञां समासाद्य विसिष्मिये च ।। ६.६९.९६ ।।
transliteration: athāṅgado muṣṭivibhinnamūrdhā susrāva tīvraṁ rudhiraṁ bhṛśoṣṇam।muhurvijajvāla mumoha cāpi sañjñāṁ samāsādya visiṣmiye ca ।। 6.69.96 ।।

translations.english: Then Angada performed that feat of valour, most hard to do and gladdening the heart of Rama; and he of dreadful deeds marvelled, and again was gladdened in the battle.
